model.realtime: META-realtime: the mutation MUST emit ViewBus.notify(viewBusKey({type,uuid})) on the ONE VIEW BUS (v0.8.116 live-bridge) for every affected unit so the GUI re-renders IN-PLACE, no reload — gated by the live-MVC standard (ViewBus callback, not poll/reload).

acceptanceCriteria.text: model.status is NEVER stored/written imperatively; it is deriveStatusEnum(statusChecklist) computed on read. The statusChecklist is the ONE source; every state change edits the checklist and status re-derives.
server.ts:1639 'm.status = In Progress' on decline is REPLACED with a CHECKLIST edit (the decline adds/uncrosses the appropriate step per CR 7286d45a); status re-derives — no direct write.
A CI must-fail lint flags any model.status = <literal or non-derive> write (allow ONLY deriveStatusEnum(...) at the read boundary). stub-must-fail: a seeded m.status='Done' trips it RED.

The displayed status (badge/checklist/scoreboard) MUST equal the unit's derived status at render time; the render reads the LIVE-derived value via the ViewBus (re-derives on unit-changed, never latches stale). Gate: rendered==derived at @390 badge; stub-must-fail on a seeded stale render.

Capture T37.25's ACTUAL rendered badge @390 FIRST: 'In Progress' => Tron mis-sighted adjacent T37.24 (non-bug); 'QA Review' => real render-drift => fix the latch/stale-bus. Do NOT design the fix before the disambiguation says which. (Planner measured stored-vs-derived DRIFT=0 board-wide, so this is RENDER-vs-derived, not stored.)
A checklist edit emits ViewBus.notify(task) -> the status badge re-derives live (as proven by the badge live-MVC at v0.8.116).

deriveStatusEnum is SUB-STEP AWARE: an OPEN "processing change requests" sub-step yields a DISTINCT band = QA-Review-with-open-CR band (NOT clean QA-Review, NOT In-Progress, NOT Done; Done gated on zero open CRs). The indented sub-step is DERIVATION-BEARING, not decorative (architect ac4913493: open CRs untick the TOP-LEVEL QA Review box, behaviour not decoration). This satisfies Tron's sketch (QA Review unticked + sub-step visible) AND his no-regress rule (the derived status NEVER falls to In-Progress while a CR is open). PO ruling 2026-08-20: deriveStatusEnum becomes SUB-STEP AWARE so an open processing-CR yields a distinct band satisfying BOTH Tron directives (his unticked-QA-Review sketch AND his no-regress-to-In-Progress rule). stub-must-fail: a task with QA Review unticked + an open processing-CR that derives In-Progress (or clean QA-Review, or Done) => RED.
